caption: The drawing depicts an interior room arranged with various ornate and decorative objects. The walls are blue with green accents and are covered in framed artworks and mounted items, including a deer head and what appears to be a large fish above a clock chandelier hanging from the ceiling. The ceiling itself has an oval stained-glass element with floral designs in multiple colors. On the left side, there is a door marked “PRIVATE HOURS 9-5” with an image of a tooth. Near the door are a topiary plant in a green pot and an umbrella stand holding umbrellas. Below the fish, there is a bust on a pedestal and a framed artwork of a person. There is a central round table with a golden base, on which rests a bouquet of pink flowers, several books, and what appears to be a folded paper. Around the table and in the seating area are several gold-colored, ornate wicker chairs and sofas, some with red or pink cushions and colorful pillows, and a patterned rug underneath. Along the right wall, there is a large folding screen with images of three cranes, and above it is a framed painting of a woman in a blue dress. The wooden floor is partially covered by rectangular rugs. The room includes framed art, a gold-framed picture of the Roman Colosseum, and other decorative items, giving the appearance of a detailed and eclectic space filled with both natural and artificial elements.
title: Dentist's Waiting Room
